envelope.description: Verify progress across native adapters, reconnect and failure

body.title: Verify progress across native adapters, reconnect and failure
body.summary: Use existing fake CLI/production IPC fixtures for both providers; prove isolated reviews, stale restart/reconnect, no extra calls, bounded writes and races. Document use and limits; no full expensive review loop.
acceptanceChecks: Both native fixtures and real IPC prove end-to-end behavior with zero hosted-model calls
Reconnect,write-failure,terminal race and concurrent review isolation covered; document matching-version recovery limits

tests.name: Both native CLI fixtures expose isolated reconnectable progress through production IPC
Progress write failure restart and terminal races preserve authoritative task outcomes
